production_read_only.access: SELECT queries in explicit READ ONLY transactions, port 5432; GET live OpenAPI; no writes
production_read_only.limitation: Rejected direct HTTP makes are not persisted, so SELECT history cannot prove whether an attempt failed or was blocked.
production_read_only.workaround: Existing /make/prepare manual substitution: Oat Bran (31) to Oats (32), selecting the actual oats lot. The direct GPT /make exclusion merely skips bran and cannot add replacement oats.

implementation.rule: Use available oat bran first; substitute rolled oats pound-for-pound for missing bran, added to normal recipe oats.
implementation.audit: Actual oats lots in transaction_lines and ingredient_lot_consumption, immutable transaction_substitutions JSON, bilingual notes and receipts, ticket and direct shift-summary display.
implementation.manual: Explicit swaps/exclusions preserved; no recipe data or migration changes.
implementation.ticket_stock_change: Confirmed input quantities stay frozen. Depleted confirmed bran requires a fresh draft; depleted oats retains normal shortage policy.
